item.title: Travel Info Website with Budget Estimator
item.description:
250-750 USD | I want to launch an easy-to-navigate website packed with practical facts for anyone planning a trip. Each country page will show currency details, recommended hotels, signature foods, transport options, cultural insights and a concise “places to visit” section. The first batch of destinations will be Egypt, Morocco, Mauritius, Botswana, Rwanda, Namibia, Vietnam and Malaysia, with the structure kept open so I can slot in more countries later without new development.
The centrepiece is an interactive trip-cost estimator. A visitor types how many days they will stay and instantly sees a total budget in US dollars. The calculation must break the cost down into hotels, transport, food, activities and entrance fees to historical sites or museums. Costs should shift automatically when the day count changes and adapt to the price range that makes sense for the traveller; some will backpack on a shoestring, others will choose mid-range or a splash of luxury, so the logic needs to accommodate all three levels.
I need a modern, responsive design that loads fast on mobile. A lightweight CMS such as WordPress (or a headless alternative if you prefer) will let me update prices, add photos and publish new country pages myself. Clean code, basic on-page SEO, Google Maps embeds and an image gallery for each destination are highly desirable.
Deliverables • Fully functioning responsive website with CMS setup • Custom trip-cost estimator integrated and tested for the eight listed countries • Clear admin guide (text or short video) showing how to edit prices, add destinations and tweak the estimator formula whats app icon
Once these items are in place and running smoothly, I will handle ongoing content updates; I just need the technical foundation built to the spec above.

item.title: Performance-Based WooCommerce SEO Australia
item.description:

**Preferred payment arrangement**

**Advice requested**
